context: Hina-young and Sakura discuss showa-era books at the library.
purpose: Two literature-loving women on historical books.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.jp: さくらさん、昭和の本、面白いですね。
lines.en: Sakura, these Showa-era books are so interesting!
lines.style: Bright, curious opening. Respectful address. Warm admiration in her voice — she's genuinely delighted. Slightly breathless with genuine enthusiasm, like she's discovering something wonderful.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 当時、インターネットなくて、新聞中心。
lines.en: Back then there was no internet, so newspapers were everything.
lines.style: Thoughtful, measured delivery. Not teaching, but sharing knowledge naturally. Soft and warm — inviting Hina into the thought. Slight pause before 'newspapers' like she's picturing it.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.jp: 万部、刷ってた、すごいですね。
lines.en: They printed ten thousand copies — that's incredible!
lines.style: Genuine amazement breaking through her composure. Slight rise in pitch on the number. Quick, eager delivery showing real respect for the scale and effort. Unguarded for a moment.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 時代の主義、よく反映されてる。
lines.en: You can really see how the beliefs of that era come through in every page.
lines.style: Calm, analytical but not cold. Speaking from understanding, not lecturing. Quiet confidence. Slight emphasis on 'really' — she's learned this through looking closely. Grown-up measured pace.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.jp: 製品としても、立派ですね、本。
lines.en: The book itself is such a beautiful object, isn't it?
lines.style: Soft wonder in her voice. Running her hand along the book in her mind. Appreciative of the craft and care that went into it. Warm and genuine, no performance — just noticing something lovely.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.en: Books like this are rare now, you know.
lines.style: Gentle, almost reverent. A small moment of melancholy underneath — aware of what's been lost. Not mourning, but respectful. Warm toward Hina, inviting her into the significance of what they're holding.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.en: I'll take really good care of it.
lines.style: Quiet certainty. A small promise made seriously, without drama. Steady voice. Not performative — just genuine commitment. The kind of thing an eight-year-old says when something matters.
